   QPR V Swansea City : Match day morning latest & team news
 Saturday, 24th Oct 2026 08:00 by Swansea Independent It’s match day on the Indy with the Swans ready to take on Queens Park Rangers at Loftus Road today (3pm) Last night Middlesbrough had an emphatic win at Bolton Wanderers 1-5 which saw them leapfrog over the Swans into first place. Only a win this afternoon for the Swans will see them return to the number one spot. 
 The way of the Championship is a long road. Todays fixtures and last night result below. 
 Swansea City have enjoyed retaining the lead in the league since last month. Now only a win will see them take that position again. Cameron Burgess, Josh Key and Ronald are all out. Key is in rehabilitation and Ronald will be out until December. Burgess is still on his long road back to full fitness. Bobby Wales has returned to the Swans for treatment from Dundee. None are available today. 
 The current league table spells out what needs to be done today.
 Swans head coach, Vitor Matos won’t reveal his team to the squad until later this morning. Team news will follow. A sold out away support will be there to cheer on the Swans as will be the Indy. Safe travels to you all.
